messages:
Elaine M: Quick sync — MicroGrid testimonial recording confirmed Wed 11am PT. Need legal sign-off on usage rights for a short quote + 30s clip (website + webinar). cc @KevinL @MariaC

Maria C: Got it. They'll ok short promo quote but want to review exact wording first. I can get release signed after language is final. ✅

Sam P: What assets do we need? raw audio, 30s cut, 1-2 stills? I’ll slot this into the calendar once assets are defined.

Ravi S: Transcript + subtitles needed. Also alt text for stills? I can draft accessibility copy.

Kevin L: Legal note: we need a signed Talent/Media Release. Also suggest tightening the quote to avoid absolute performance claims. Proposed redline below.

Elaine M: Paste it here, Kevin. Maria — can you check tone with the contact? We want punchy but not a hard promise.

Kevin L: Suggested edit:
```
Original: "Redwood cut our inference cost by 70% and made responses instant for our users."
Suggested: "Since switching to Redwood Inference, we've seen a significant reduction in inference costs and noticeably faster responses for our users."
```
Reason: removes specific percent and uses cautious language (seen/noticeably) so it's testimonial, not a factual claim.

Maria C: Sending that phrasing to the customer now with: "Can you confirm this phrasing is accurate and you're comfortable with our use in web + webinar?" Will chase for signature. ETA EOD tomorrow.

Sam P: For assets I need:
- raw call (mp3)
- 30s edit (mp4 H.264)
- 2 photos (1200px width)
- plain-text transcript + VTT
Please add to project folder and tag me: https://drive.redwood/marketing/microgrid-testimonial

Ravi S: I'll draft alt text and captions once photos are uploaded. I can also create the VTT if transcript is in Google Doc.

Elaine M: Ops q's: 1) Embargo? 2) Do we need partner logo clearance?

Maria C: Embargo: none requested but they prefer we wait until their product announcement (~2 weeks). I'll flag that. Logo: marketing lead said yes — will share approved lockup.

Kevin L: On release: I'll prepare a one-page release with usage scope (web, social, webinar), duration option (perpetual vs 12 months). Recommend perpetual but leave checkbox for customer to choose. Also adding checklist to the doc.

Elaine M: Perpetual ok if they sign, otherwise 12 months is fine. Maria, ask about preferred duration and get logo PNG. Sam, once signed can you set tentative publish T+14 days and keep flex.

Sam P: Will tentatively schedule T+14 in content calendar and add upload-to-CDN task + embed code for blog.

Maria C: Sent wording to contact; CC'ing Kevin on the release. Will post when signed.

deploy-bot: Calendar invite created for Wed 11:00 AM PT — MicroGrid Testimonial Session. Attendees: Elaine M, Maria C, Customer Rep.

Maria C: Update — customer approved Kevin's edit and signed the release. Uploading signed PDF to folder now.

Sam P: Assets received (raw mp3, two stills, transcript). Starting 30s cut now; will upload final clip by EOD.

Ravi S: Alt text and VTT drafted and uploaded under /accessibility. Quick review welcome.

Kevin L: Reviewed release; all set. If we quote numbers in blog run past me first. Otherwise green to publish once customer goes live.

Elaine M: Great work team. Publish plan: hold until customer's announcement, then publish blog + clip and add webinar supporting content. I'll create launch checklist and link it here. :rocket:
